turns.text: ok just came from pedros 4pm group at the library and i wanna drill the digestive system off his quiz sheet. can u quiz me? one q at a time pls
Happy to. Starting easy: what is the path food takes from the mouth to the anus? List the organs in order, including the accessory organs that don't touch the food directly if you can.
mouth pharynx esophagus stomach small intestine (duodenum jejunum ileum) large intestine rectum anus. accessory: salivary glands liver gallbladder pancreas
Perfect, nothing missing. Next: which cells in the stomach secrete HCl, and which secrete pepsinogen?
parietal = HCl, chief = pepsinogen. ok this is weirdly fun rn bc i got into intro to nutrition this morning so the digestion unit actually feels like it means something ☕
Congrats on getting the seat! Nice that the material connects. Next: where does most nutrient absorption happen, and what structures increase the surface area there?
small intestine, mostly jejunum. villi and microvilli and the circular folds
Right on all counts. Want me to keep going, or turn this into a plan for the next lab?
plan pls. too long just bullets. and also a script for mentioning the nutrition class at home. i dont want it to turn into a whole convo lol, just kinda mention it in passing

Quiz plan (20-minute blocks):
- 0:00-0:20: Organ order + accessory organs, from memory on a blank page
- 0:20-0:40: Stomach and small intestine: cell types, enzymes, secretions
- 0:40-1:00: Liver, gallbladder, pancreas: what each secretes and where it enters
- 1:00-1:20: Large intestine + absorption/hormone review
- 1:20-1:40: Re-quiz everything you missed

Home script (low-key, said while doing something else like setting the table):
- "Oh, I registered for my spring classes today. One's Intro to Nutrition."
- If asked why: "It fit my schedule and I liked the digestion unit."
- Then change the subject: "What's for dinner?"

Timing:
- Say it at dinner, mid-meal, not at the start
- Keep it to one sentence and don't add explanations unless asked
- Keep it as a passing remark, not an announcement
ok that actually helps a lot. the timed blocks are perfect 😭 thank u. ok im gonna eat now
Glad it helps! Go eat, and good luck with the next lab. Come back anytime for more quizzing.
